summary: Verified the stock.tsx regression fix: all 8 items in the Stock tab (Adeba Rice 50kg, Cement 50kg, Cooking Oil 5L, Delivery within Lagos, Detergent 1kg, Semovita 10kg, Sugar 50kg, TEST Rice 25kg) now render real photo thumbnails via the shared component (40x40 rounded tile) instead of the generic cube-outline icon avatar. No item fell back to the icon-avatar branch since all items now have photo_url — code path for the fallback (Av icon) remains intact and would not crash if triggered. Quick Sale screen sanity-checked: loads correctly, renders item photos (Adeba Rice, Cement, Cooking Oil, Delivery truck) with no regressions, no red screen errors.
